body:
```patch

From 7beda8e105e05eb3b3c7e0c6b2f99a069370137f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2017 17:34:36 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] Fix encoder exceptions being discarded when writing with a VoidPromise.

Motivation:

According to documentation of Channel#voidPromise(), if encoding of the message throws an exception, exception should be passed to the channel pipeline.
Unfortunately, that's not the case, which this commit fixes.
I've been ripping my hair out for hours trying to find out a memory leak without any clue.
There was an exception thrown in my handler which made the reason very obvious, but it was being silently discarded.
Fixes #6622

Modifications:

Fix the logic of notifyOutboundHandler to handle a case when the promise is not void.

Result:

Encoder exceptions will be properly propagated to the pipeline when used with void promise, in accordance to javadocs of Channel#voidPromise()
---
 transport/src/main/java/io/netty/channel/AbstractChannelHandlerContext.java | 2 ++
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 0 deletions(-)

diff --git a/transport/src/main/java/io/netty/channel/AbstractChannelHandlerContext.java b/transport/src/main/java/io/netty/channel/AbstractChannelHandlerContext.java
index 55e596f..d138307 100644
--- a/transport/src/main/java/io/netty/channel/AbstractChannelHandlerContext.java
+++ b/transport/src/main/java/io/netty/channel/AbstractChannelHandlerContext.java
@@ -834,6 +834,8 @@ abstract class AbstractChannelHandlerContext extends DefaultAttributeMap
     private static void notifyOutboundHandlerException(Throwable cause, ChannelPromise promise) {
         if (!(promise instanceof VoidChannelPromise)) {
             PromiseNotificationUtil.tryFailure(promise, cause, logger);
+        } else {
+            invokeExceptionCaught(t);
         }
     }
 
--
libgit2 0.24.0
```
@normanmaurer could you take a look at this patch :)

issue.title: VoidChannelPromise not notified when exception is thrown.

repository.name: netty
repository.description: Netty project - an event-driven asynchronous network application framework

issue.body:
Motivation:

When a VoidChannelPromise is used by the user we need to ensure we propergate the exception through the ChannelPipeline otherwise the exception will just be swallowed and so the user has no idea whats going on.

Modifications:

- Always call tryFailure / trySuccess even when we use the VoidChannelPromise
- Add unit test

Result:

Fixes [#6622].
